question: The soluble globular proteins are characterized by:

options.opa: Present aromatic and aliphatic amino acids on its surface.
options.opc: Being partially deployed giving rise to structures that are not very compact.
options.opd: Present in its interior acidic and basic amino acids.
options.ope: A high degree of hydration inside.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Soluble globular proteins -> have a three-dimensional structure -> with hydrophobic amino acids buried inside -> forming an inner apolar core -> 90% CHAIN: Soluble globular proteins -> have a tertiary structure -> with hydrophilic amino acids on the surface -> including aromatic and aliphatic amino acids -> 80% CHAIN: Soluble globular proteins -> can undergo conformational changes -> leading to partially deployed structures -> which may not be very compact -> 70% CHAIN: Soluble globular proteins -> contain a variety of amino acids -> including acidic and basic residues -> which can be found in the interior -> 80% CHAIN: Soluble globular proteins -> have a high degree of hydration -> creating a polar environment inside -> 90%
analysis: Soluble globular proteins are typically characterized by having an inner apolar core, which contributes to their overall structure and function.
